messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for inference-gateway (us-west-2). Error spike started ~3876543180. Autoscale triggered but 502/504s rising. Paging maya (oncall-sre).
maya: on it. seeing a correlated spike in prefix-cache miss rate and a lot of KV timeouts. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123 (read-only). brief please: impact surface?
hana: support reports customer-facing API errors for ~8 customers, mostly chat endpoints. Some customers see complete request failures, others high tail latency.
raj: logs show repeated prefix lookups returning checksum_mismatch for some shards, then eviction floods. Example trace:
```
2026-03-15T10:26:12Z gateway -> runtime: GET /v1/chat
prefix_lookup shard=13 key=abc.. failed checksum_mismatch expected=0x9f3 got=0x1b2
prefetch queued -> eviction(event=burst) -> backend gateway timeout
```
li: that checksum_mismatch suggests either disk corruption or a race in the compaction/flush path. But the sudden eviction flood timing aligns with a config push ~3876543000 that lowered prefix-cache max_entries.
maya: can we confirm if the config push was rolled out to all regions? raj, li, are any nodes still on old config?
raj: running `curl -s http://infra-config/api/current | jq '.prefix_cache.max_entries'` across pods — most are at 8k, a handful at 512. mismatch window exists. Running a quick grep on deploy logs.
li: yep - Canary left at 512 for ~3m due to a confusing flag gating. Canary then promoted accidentally. That pushed low-entry config cluster-wide during a traffic spike. low threshold + compaction triggered mass evictions -> hot rehydration -> KV thundering herd -> gateway 502s.
maya: mitigation plan: 1) immediate rollback of prefix_cache.max_entries to previous value 8192; 2) enable eviction-throttle on shard coordinator; 3) route ~30% traffic to failover region (us-east-1) for affected customers; 4) handoff to next oncall after stabilization.
hana: notifying affected customers with temporary workaround: set regional fallback (customers on hosted plan) and inform SLO impact. Draft note: "Investigation in progress — intermittent 5xx when sending requests to us-west-2. We are routing traffic to other regions and expect recovery within 20-40m." Want me to send now?
maya: send now. put support-runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefix-cache-eviction
raj: rolling config rollback now: `kubectl -n runtime set env ds/prefix-cache CONFIG_PREFIX_MAX=8192 --record` — doing a staggered rollout by shard group to avoid another eviction wave. Starting group A.
li: also enabling eviction-throttle: `curl -XPOST https://coord.local/_admin/throttle -d '{"rate":1000}'` on coordinator leader.
raj: group A done, metrics show miss_rate dropping and 5xx per-gateway down 30%.
maya: keep groups staggered 30s apart. monitor backend latencies and KV p99.
hana: support update posted. customers pinging slack thread. one big customer (AcmeCorp) sees partial failures, assigned to account lead.
oz: product asks if any data lost/corruption beyond checksum flags? Is there risk customers see bad completions?
li: checksum_mismatch indicates detected inconsistency — reads fail rather than return corrupt data. No evidence of silent corrupt writes. We'll run a targeted scan on affected shards after stabilization: `kv-checksum-verify --shard 10-20 --repair-policy=log`.
maya: temp firewall: if any node reports repeated checksum_mismatch > 5/s, we should isolate it from serving and mark for full disk scrub.
raj: group B rolled back. metrics trending good. gateway 502s down to baseline over last 3m. p99 latency improving.
maya: good. keep monitoring for 15m. If stable, escalate to postmortem. Also tag deploy that caused the flag promotion — validate rollout gating.
li: creating an incident task to add stronger gating and automated canary rollback when eviction_rate > threshold. filing ticket INF-4321.
hana: customers updated with ETA 30m and routed traffic note.
maya: handing off to next oncall (li) at 3876543375. summary for handoff:
- root cause: accidental promotion of low prefix_cache.max_entries during high traffic -> eviction storm -> KV timeouts -> gateway 5xx
- mitigation: rolled back config to 8192 staggered by shard group, enabled eviction-throttle, routed 30% traffic to us-east-1, isolated misbehaving nodes
- current status: 5xx rate back to near baseline, miss_rate decreasing, no data corruption observed beyond checksum detections
- next steps: full checksum sweep on affected shards, add gating/automated rollback, postmortem and customer RCA
li: acknowledged, I'll watch for next 1h and start the checksum sweep. ping me if any regressions. assigning follow-ups to eng-infra + runtime.
maya: thanks team. closing paging and switching to postmortem flow. :thumbsup:
